analysis.summary: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited reported its audited financial results and investor presentation for FY26 and H2 FY26, highlighting an aggregate installed biodiesel manufacturing capacity of 170 KLPD across its Phulera and Meerut plants. The company serves major Oil Marketing Companies under long-term contracts and is expanding into Compressed BioGas and biomass pellets. Management emphasized strategic growth through its subsidiary Nirvaanraj Energy and newly incorporated Rajputana Agro LLP, alongside achieving VERRA carbon credit certification. Consolidated revenue from operations for FY26 stood at Rs. 12,202.92 lakhs with a profit after tax of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated the company is on track to become a single source solution for renewable energy in solid, liquid, and gas segments.
guidance.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.
demand_outlook.quote: If I talk about the European Union region, the demand is even higher as there is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.

demand_outlook.claim: India has an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel under the National Biofuels Policy of 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: As per National Biofuels Policy of 2018, there is an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work for the compressed biogas project is expected to start by January end.
capex_expansion.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work for the export unit tapping the European Union and marine blending market in the GCC will begin by January end.
capex_expansion.quote: By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity at the Phulera and Meerut units has been enhanced by almost 3-4 times.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully enhanced capacity at our Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.

capex_expansion.claim: Rajputana Biodiesel is expanding its business into Compressed Biogas and Biomass Pellets.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in the CBG sector are reported to be more than 55%-60%.
margins_costs.quote: But trust me, the EBITDA margins are more than 55%-60% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: The unit economics in the GCC region show an estimated 10% to 12% margin on revenues.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of unit economics, there is almost a 12%, 15% margin you make on your revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: The company supplies biodiesel to major Oil Marketing Companies including HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL under long-term supply contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Rajputana serves major Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) — HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL — under long-term supply contracts and is now expanding into Compressed BioGas (CBG) and Biomass Pellets.

orders_capacity.claim: Previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR 100 crores will be completed by November end of the year.
orders_capacity.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in its history for the November to March 2026 OMC tender.
orders_capacity.quote: I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds long-term supply contracts with major Oil Marketing Companies HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.
orders_capacity.quote: Long-term supply contracts with OMC's (HPCL, BPCL and IOCL)

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that recent large-scale PSU orders, capacity expansions, and plant tech upgrades reaffirm its strategic roadmap.
orders_capacity.quote: The recent large-scale orders from government PSUs, investments in capacity expansion, technological upgrades at biodiesel plants, along with our entry into the CBG and Pellets segment, collectively reaffirm our strategic roadmap toward becoming a comprehensive and integrated BioEnergy company.

capital_allocation.claim: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited holds a 99% controlling stake in Rajputana Agro LLP.
capital_allocation.quote: Ownership: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited holds a 99% controlling stake in the LLP.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital raised in the IPO was utilized for immediate working capital needs, technical upgradation, and capacity enhancement.
capital_allocation.quote: We successfully utilized the capital raised in our IPO for immediate working capital needs and technical upgradation along with capacity enhancement.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic roadmap includes deleveraging its balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Pricing sometimes becomes a point of discussion during policy reviews in the biodiesel sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only thing is that sometimes in the review of policy, pricing becomes a point of discussion.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.
management_commitments.quote: "We remain focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.

management_commitments.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

management_commitments.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

management_commitments.quote: By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

management_commitments.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.
